status: Exploratory hypotheses registered after viewing the session; not preregistered or out-of-sample evidence.
baseline: All 52 supplied trades, reported dollar P&L; fees unspecified.
method: Retain historical rows meeting each entry condition. Preserve their actual reported outcomes; do not change side, exits or size. No portfolio replay or claim of achievable filtered returns.

experiments.name: Skip labeled squeezes
experiments.rationale: Inspect weak separation of fast EMAs
experiments.rule: No SQUEEZE label in supplied data

experiments.name: Skip trades against persistent VWAP side
experiments.rule: Exclude PUT when above-VWAP share >=80%; exclude CALL when share <=20%

experiments.name: No squeeze and no persistent VWAP conflict
experiments.rationale: Separate local chop and broader direction

experiments.name: ATR at least 3 basis points
experiments.rationale: Inspect small underlying moves relative to execution frictions
experiments.rule: ATR bp >=3; exploratory threshold from existing research

failure_criteria: A nonpositive retained average reported P&L fails this session's descriptive screen. Positive results remain unvalidated; a tiny or concentrated retained sample is insufficient. Actual promotion requires new chronological evidence, realistic option costs, and portfolio replay.
